flags.cells.retention.wipPushOnTurnEnd: default false. On: every turn end / runtime exit of a Cell bee snapshots the WIP (tracked modifications, deletions, staged changes, untracked files; ignored paths never) in the retention worker, pushes it to refs/hive/wip/<cell-id> in the origin, reads it back and records wip_sha/wip_tree/wip_pushed_at/wip_confirmed_at on the cells row; a revive of an evicted Cell restores the confirmed WIP into the fresh checkout as working-tree state
flags.cells.retention.evictionRequiresWip: default false. On: an eviction pushes again and proceeds only when the push is confirmed (then forces past the dirty guard: dirty_uncommitted and dirty_unlanded no longer hold a Cell, the ref carries the work); an unconfirmed push holds the Cell as wip_unconfirmed, sets capacity.resourceBlocked.reason = wip_unconfirmed and, under budgetEnforce, refuses new Cells with resource_blocked; nothing is deleted

alwaysOn: parked-first eviction ranking: parked Cells (parked_at set by cell.park and idle trims, cleared when a runtime starts in the Cell) rank before archived bees, then by idle time, in the byte-budget and pressure passes
cell.remove / cell.retained.remove drop the WIP ref; eviction keeps it

schema.measured: .proof/h-track/h3/migration-v53.json: live store copy (1.15 GB, 3554 cells) 51 -> 53 open+migrate 11.15 s, of which the five ADD COLUMNs 41 ms and the open path's pre-migration backup copy the rest
schema.mirror: MIRROR_CELL_KEYS gained the five fields; cell.put deltas carry them

capacityShape.cells.wipBlockedCells: number, optional, count of Cells whose eviction-time push is unconfirmed

gates.wipPushMeasured: .proof/h-track/h3/wip-measure.json: this Cell (5801 tracked files, 90 changed paths) snapshot 177 ms, push 1.6 s, read-back 41 ms after seeding the temp index from .git/index and excluding files over 64 MiB (before the fix: 94 s / 28 s because every tracked file was rehashed and a 1.15 GB untracked store copy was pushed)
gates.neverMidTurn: pushes run at turn end or exit; eviction keeps its runtime_live / op_in_flight / move / handoff preconditions and re-checks them at the rename
gates.unconfirmedBlocksNeverDeletes: cell-wip.2: an origin whose refs dir refuses writes holds the Cell (reason wip_unconfirmed), the unpushed file stays on disk, health.capacity.resourceBlocked = {blocked: true, reason: wip_unconfirmed}, wipBlockedCells 1, admission refuse, spawn of a Cell bee refused with resource_blocked; the next confirmed push evicts and clears the block
gates.readBackBeforeDelete: cell-wip.1: a dirty stopped Cell is evicted only after the eviction-time push is confirmed (ref in origin == recorded sha, commit and tree present); the WIP commit's parent is the Cell's HEAD; revive brings notes.md and the README change back at the same HEAD with .next absent; cell.remove drops the ref
gates.thirtyDayGate: zero evictions without a confirmed ref in 30 days is a deployment observation, not provable here; every eviction under the flag logs cell.retention.evicted ... wip=<sha>

notProven: a remote (non-local) origin: Cells clone from local repositories and pushWip fetches into the origin repository on disk; a network origin needs a push-based transport behind the same functions
WIP restore cost on revive runs synchronously in onCellMaterialized (read-tree -m -u of the WIP delta only); not measured on a large delta
